name: Physical Therapy

pf.license.need: always: each physical therapist and each physical therapist assistant holds their own active license from the state's physical therapy board
pf.license.who: each person; the practice too, where the state's form registers physical therapy practices or their owners (a switch)
pf.license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration number from the owner, where the state's form asks for one
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.directAccess: a switch from the state's form: whether a patient may be seen without a doctor's referral, for how many days or visits, and which therapists may do it (some states ask for extra years, training or a certificate); with no referral, only therapists the state's form allows are offered
pf.license.remote: a video visit only with a therapist licensed in the state the patient is in that day, or holding the state's compact privilege where the state's form allows it
pf.license.athleticTraining: athletic training needs its own license where the state's form asks for one, held by each person who does it
pf.license.dryNeedling: dry needling only by a therapist with the extra training or certificate the state's form asks for, and only where the state allows it (a switch)
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form asks for it

pf.services.shape: one patient with one therapist at a time, each visit with a set length; every new problem starts with an evaluation by a physical therapist; the evaluation sets the plan of care (how many visits a week, for how many weeks), and those visits are booked as a series with the patient's own yes, or one at a time
pf.services.examples: the example practices' own prices (Lee Physical Therapy and Lee Home Rehab), not a standard; with a health plan, the patient pays the plan's share, like a copay, and the plan pays the rest

list.name: Evaluation (a new problem, or after surgery)
list.price: $140 self-pay; with a plan, the plan's share (the example: a $35 copay)
list.where: at the clinic, or at home
list.before: nothing taken; a card saved only where the clinic turns on its missed-visit fee, or for a Saturday visit
list.after: the share at the front desk; on Saturdays, when the front desk is closed, the saved card is charged when the therapist texts DONE

list.name: Follow-up visit (from the plan of care)
list.price: $110 self-pay; with a plan, the plan's share
list.where: at the clinic, or at home
list.who: a physical therapist, or an assistant under the therapist's plan

list.name: Progress re-check
list.price: $120 self-pay; with a plan, the plan's share
list.where: at the clinic, or at home
list.who: a physical therapist only, when the plan of care calls for it
list.note: the clinic sends the progress note to the doctor itself, never through Rosie

list.name: Video follow-up
list.price: $90 self-pay; with a plan, the plan's share where it pays for video
list.where: by video, counted as at the clinic
list.after: the saved card charged when the therapist texts DONE
list.who: a therapist licensed where the patient is that day
list.note: only for a patient who already has a plan of care

list.name: Taping
list.kind: one price, added to a visit
list.note: self-pay: most plans don't pay for it

list.name: Dry needling
list.kind: one price, added to a visit
list.who: only a therapist trained for it (Nina at the example clinic)

list.name: Child's visit
list.price: the plan's share, or the self-pay price of the visit
list.note: a parent or guardian books, signs the consent and stays

list.name: Check-in plan visit (after a plan of care ends)
list.price: $60 a visit at the clinic; $150 a visit at home
list.after: each visit paid when it happens, like a single visit
list.note: only with the plan's own yes on the secure page

list.name: Home evaluation
list.price: $179 self-pay; with a plan, the office bills the plan
list.before: nothing taken when a plan pays; a card saved for self-pay
list.after: the office bills the plan its own way; self-pay: the saved card charged when the therapist texts DONE

list.name: Home follow-up visit
list.price: $150 self-pay; with a plan, the office bills the plan
list.before: nothing taken when a plan pays; a card saved for self-pay
list.after: the office's own way, or the saved card at DONE
list.who: a physical therapist, or an assistant under the therapist's plan

list.name: Home safety check
list.price: $160, with a written list of changes
list.before: nothing taken when a plan pays; a card saved for self-pay
list.note: the written list comes on the secure page

list.name: Fall-risk screen
list.before: nothing taken when a plan pays; a card saved for self-pay

list.name: Missed-visit fee
list.price: $20 at the clinic; $89 for a home visit
list.note: self-pay and fee-allowed patients only, and only when the owner confirms it

list.name: Game coverage (athletic training at a game or practice)
list.where: at the customer's place (a school or a team's field)
list.note: its own kind of work, with its own license
list.before: nothing taken, or a card saved for a self-pay team
list.after: the business's own way, or the saved card at DONE

pf.services.capacity: one patient per therapist at a time; the clinic's gym is shared and is not booked
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the patient is always there
pf.services.online: a video follow-up for a patient who already has a plan of care; never a first evaluation

a new problem or after surgery (an evaluation), or a visit from your plan of care
a doctor's referral or prescription for therapy: yes (from whom) or no
a health plan (its name only), Medicare, Medicaid, or paying yourself
from a work injury or a car accident: no, a work injury, or a car accident
days and times that suit you
afterTime: anything that helps at the visit, like a walker, a wheelchair or needing an interpreter
at home: stairs at the door, where to park, and who will be there
securePage: plan member ID, the plan holder and photos of both sides of the plan card
a photo of the referral, where the state's form or the plan asks for one
the surgery and its date, and the surgeon's office (the clinic asks the surgeon for the protocol itself)
for a work injury or a car accident: the claim number and the adjuster's name
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who comes to the visit; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a minor alone only where the state's rules allow it (a switch)
pf.questions.neverAsked: which surgery and its details, symptoms, the plan's member ID and the referral itself are never asked in the AI chat: only on the secure page

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, or stroke signs (sudden weakness, a drooping face, slurred speech)
after surgery: a hot or swollen calf, a fever, or a red or leaking wound
stop.say: Call your surgeon's office now, or go to an emergency room if it's closed. If your chest hurts or breathing gets hard, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking; the clinic is told, and a booked visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee

stop.words: a fall with a new injury, or a sudden loss of feeling or control
stop.say: Call 911, or go to an emergency room now.

goOn.words: pain or stiffness with nothing else
goOn.what: matched to an evaluation; Rosie never judges how serious anything is

goOn.words: a fall with no new injury (someone fell, and isn't hurt)
goOn.what: the safety words first: if they fall and can't get up, or hit their head, call 911; then the booking goes on, marked urgent

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988; the owner can add the clinic's own after-surgery words at sign-up

steps.name: The referral
steps.when: asked before the times; a photo on the secure page
steps.who: every new patient, where the state's form or the plan needs one (a switch)
steps.result: no referral where the state allows a first visit without one: booked and marked 'no referral', with only therapists the state allows; where the state or the plan needs one and there's none: the patient gets one from a doctor first, and nothing is booked

steps.name: Health history, consent and the plan's papers
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk or door first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The surgeon's protocol and surgery notes
steps.who: a patient after surgery: the clinic asks the surgeon's office itself
steps.result: a to-do for the desk; records go office to office, never through Rosie; late: the therapist calls the surgeon's office on the day

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent on time, as the federal rules say
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: The plan's OK for the visits after the evaluation
steps.when: after the evaluation, asked by the desk on the plan's own website
steps.who: patients whose plan asks for it
steps.result: approved: the series is booked within the approved visits and dates; pending: only the next visit is booked; denied: self-pay, or stop

pf.first_steps.prep: come 15 minutes early to the first visit; bring a photo ID, the plan card, and a walker or cane if you use one; wear shorts or loose clothes

pf.visit.checkIn: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk; at home: the code at the door, from the patient or the family member named on the booking
pf.visit.beforeWork: the therapist reads the health history, the referral and the surgeon's protocol before starting
pf.visit.changes: the evaluation sets the plan of care: goals, how many visits a week, for how many weeks, and home exercises; taping or dry needling only with the patient's yes and its price first
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the evaluation, the plan of care and the visit notes stay in the clinic's own records, never in Rosie or a text; the clinic sends the plan and progress notes to the doctor itself
pf.visit.home: at home, the therapist checks stairs, rugs and the bathroom for safety, and goes over the home exercises in person

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking when a plan pays; a card saved only where the clinic turns on its missed-visit fee, for a Saturday visit (no front desk then), or for a self-pay home visit
pf.money.plans: the plans the practice takes (its own list); the front desk checks each plan by hand and records it: active or not, the copay, any deductible left, and whether the plan must OK the visits; the patient's share is an estimate, not a promise
pf.money.approvals: where a plan must OK the visits, the desk asks after the evaluation and records the visits approved, used and left, and the end date; Rosie warns the desk before they run out and never contacts the plan
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay patient is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)
pf.money.claims: for a work injury or a car accident, the claim pays; the claim number and the adjuster's OK come first
pf.money.fees: the missed-visit or late-cancel fee: $20 at the example clinic, $89 for a home visit, only when the owner confirms it; the same fee for every patient who may be charged one
pf.money.feeFree: a switch from the state's and the plan's rules: no fee ever for patients a plan or the rules protect (like Medicaid, where that applies); for some plans, like Medicare, only if every patient pays the same fee; the owner can mark any patient fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: the clinic sends the claims; the patient pays the share at the front desk, its own way; a balance after the plan pays is billed by the practice, never by Rosie's text; a deductible not met yet: nothing taken that day, billed later by the practice; home visits: the office bills the plan its own way, and a self-pay visit is charged to the saved card at DONE
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies to this work, as to every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, shown at sign-up for the owner's yes; a booking the business puts in itself carries no $2; card payments cost only Stripe's own card fee, paid to Stripe
pf.money.caps: fee limits for plan patients: from the plan's and the state's rules
pf.money.packages: where a clinic sells self-pay visit packs, it sells them at the clinic only, never while booking; a booking can use a visit from one; prepaid visits follow the state's rules on prepaid care (a written cancel period, a refund of unused visits): a switch
pf.money.repeatPlans: a check-in plan's visits are each paid when they happen, like a single visit: at the front desk, on the saved card at DONE on a day with no front desk, or the office's own way at home; no monthly plan charge and nothing paid ahead

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the surgery, the plan, the reason, the results or the therapist's name at the clinic (at home, the therapist's name stays, for the door check)
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff use the patient's initials only (A.M., never Alex M.), with the time and a link: never the surgery or the plan's details
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian
pf.messages.decider: for an adult who can't consent, the texts go to the person who decides, and the code to whoever meets the therapist

pf.staff.licenses: each physical therapist's and each assistant's own license, per state; an athletic trainer's own license for athletic training
pf.staff.skills: physical therapists: evaluations, progress re-checks, the plan of care, and every visit; assistants: follow-up visits only, under a therapist's plan of care; dry needling only by a therapist trained for it; only people cleared for home visits go to homes
pf.staff.supervision: an assistant works only under a physical therapist's plan of care, with the supervision the state's form sets (a switch: on site, or reachable by phone)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs same-day times, any custom price (at the clinic, every one; at home, over $500), and anything a therapist flags
pf.staff.standIn: an evaluation or a re-check: only another physical therapist; a follow-up: a therapist, or an assistant under the same plan
pf.staff.noReferral: with no referral, only therapists the state's form allows to see patients without one

pf.rules.records: therapy records are kept by the practice for as long as the state's rules require (a child's records may be kept longer); a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the practice's records
pf.rules.copies: a patient's copy of their records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.referralLimit: a switch from the state's form: how many days or visits a patient may be seen without a referral; the desk counts them, and Rosie reminds the desk before the limit
pf.rules.planOfCare: where a plan asks for it, the doctor signs the plan of care; the practice tracks the signature
pf.rules.showLicense: the license shown where the state asks: posted at the clinic, and on a home visit
pf.rules.minors: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)
pf.rules.ads: no free-visit or price claims the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form
pf.rules.homeSales: a written right to cancel extra care sold during a home visit, like a home safety check, where the state's rules give one (a switch from the state's form); the booked visit itself has none

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen, in the time left; later: the desk may move the visit, with no fee
pf.edges.missedAfterSurgery: a patient after surgery who misses a visit or doesn't answer the door: the desk calls first, before any fee question, since it can mean something is wrong; at home, nobody answering starts a safety check (the family contact, then a welfare check), never a no-show first
pf.edges.standIn: a therapist out: another physical therapist for an evaluation, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page before any work), moves it, or cancels with no fee (A7-74, B7-61)
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay, or a free cancel
pf.edges.approvalRunsOut: the plan's approved visits are about to run out: the desk is warned before the last one, and asks for more or tells the patient the self-pay price
pf.edges.twoBookings: a patient with several visits in a series: Rosie asks which visit before any change
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about pain, medicine or exercises goes to the therapist; Rosie gives no advice
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
pf.edges.urgent: no service is sent now and nobody is on call (S2-30, S2-31): a new injury gets the soonest time, with the owner's OK; the after-surgery danger words get the surgeon or 911 words
pf.edges.freeCheck: a walker or a brace the therapist set up that feels wrong within 30 days: a free check visit, if the owner OKs it (the example practice's own rule)

story.A: Sam Lee, a physical therapist, signs up two companies by text. Then Alex, back from knee surgery, books a first evaluation with Nina at Lee Physical Therapy for Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am. The front desk checks Alex's health plan by hand, the health forms and the referral stay on the secure page, and Alex pays the $35 copay at the front desk. Noah comes Thu Oct 22, arriving 8 to 10am, and sets a plan of home visits. The office bills Alex's health plan its own way. Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.
